# teamrig

> A Claude Code plugin and CLI that runs a team of Claude Code sessions: a shared task register, per-session inboxes, team rules loaded at every start, helpers' included, that win over conflicting local rules unless you keep them, a guard on pushes to protected branches, a hold on messages that would wake an idle session at full price, a wake for an idle session when urgent work is handed to it, each session's token use measured against the week's pace, bursts that spend a week's projected surplus once a person starts one, a nudge that keeps the lead deciding and delegating rather than doing the work itself, and the lead's daily meeting with the owner, its agenda gathered in one call.

## Guide

- [teamrig guide](https://github.com/GeneralA6/teamrig/blob/main/plugins/teamrig/skills/teamrig-guide/SKILL.md): start here: the model, which session you are, where files live, the daily loop
- [Commands](https://github.com/GeneralA6/teamrig/blob/main/plugins/teamrig/skills/teamrig-guide/commands.md): every command with its flags, an example and its output, the token budget and bursts included
- [Tasks, inbox, checks, plans and skills](https://github.com/GeneralA6/teamrig/blob/main/plugins/teamrig/skills/teamrig-guide/tasks.md): task fields (a plain-words description of what and why among them), statuses and the dependency tree, inbox lines and messages, check flags, week plans, skill rules
- [Workflows](https://github.com/GeneralA6/teamrig/blob/main/plugins/teamrig/skills/teamrig-guide/workflows.md): a work block, handing work over, waiting (on a peer's work by its task), shipping a change, closing a task, a handover, a lead checkpoint, the owner's daily meeting
- [Hooks and permissions](https://github.com/GeneralA6/teamrig/blob/main/plugins/teamrig/skills/teamrig-guide/hooks.md): what each hook injects or blocks (the team rules a helper starts with, the live task list, with the tasks waiting on the session, after a refresh or a compaction, a helper or session sent back once to a skill edit Claude Code refused), what the mod runs in a tab (/teamrig <command> with no model turn, the refresh's /clear, /reload-plugins after an install, the wake on urgent work), and the permission modes tested
- [Errors and refusals](https://github.com/GeneralA6/teamrig/blob/main/plugins/teamrig/skills/teamrig-guide/errors.md): what teamrig prints when it stops, and the fix
- [Requirements](https://github.com/GeneralA6/teamrig/blob/main/plugins/teamrig/skills/teamrig-guide/requirements.md): Claude Code, Node.js, git, terminals, the status line, operating systems, and the check that says what is missing

## Design

- [How it works](https://github.com/GeneralA6/teamrig/blob/main/docs/how-it-works.md): the design, the files, safe pushes, updating the plugin
- [GitHub sync](https://github.com/GeneralA6/teamrig/blob/main/docs/github-sync.md): reading GitHub issues into the task list: repositories, their sessions, a read-only token per owner, the automatic sync every 15 minutes, and each failure's fix
- [Team config schema](https://github.com/GeneralA6/teamrig/blob/main/plugins/teamrig/config.schema.json): every key a team config may hold

## Optional

- [teamrig-pane guide](https://github.com/GeneralA6/teamrig-pane/blob/main/plugins/teamrig-pane/skills/teamrig-pane-guide/SKILL.md): the task pane plugin that shows a session's tasks beside the conversation
